description: S08 GT derivation rule thresholds (decision ledger S08_pre_implementation_decisions.md P1). Values frozen by the P1.2 train-only calibration (runs/S08_gt_backfill/calibration_report.md, 2026-10-02): pool cone/disc per user decision with class ranges scaled by 0.75 (45/30/15); corridor d_risk raised to 3.0/2.0 per user decision; motion and action kept at provisional defaults. small_following_gap is REMOVED from the taxonomy (calibration showed <=0.64% detection, starved) so the gap section is gone. Truncation exemption verified train-only (runs/S08_gt_backfill/truncation_risk_report.md, 2026-10-02): pool truncation share 11.33% (2,655/23,425 anchors, above the 5% target) carries a measured cost of 26 missed-evidence frames (0.111%), i.e. frames whose yield_required GT would flip to True if the top-8 cap were lifted — recorded as a known limitation under the visibility-first principle. Units: distances meters, angles degrees, times seconds. corridor.* implements the t0 bilateral constant-velocity (CV) counterfactual extrapolation that replaces 'future trajectory / occupancy' for the corridor family; braking./stationary_obstacle./congestion.* keep actual-trajectory evidence windows (direct observables, no self-defeating trap).
